ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is label E in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a plant cell schematic diagram, with a shape close to rectangular, and a relatively thick, relatively dark outer boundary around it; inside this outer boundary, a thinner inner boundary and intracellular structures can also be seen. Label E is on the left side, and its arrow points to the thick boundary on the outermost side of the cell, rather than to an internal organelle. Reasoning: The thick and rigid boundary on the outermost layer of a plant cell is the cell wall, and the cell membrane is located inside the cell wall. Therefore, label E indicates the cell wall.
